title.zh: 贝叶斯 · 先查底子，再看证据
title.en: Bayes · Check the Base Rate Before the Evidence

desc.zh: 检测说你阳性，你真中招的概率只有 9%——检测没骗你，是底子太薄。先验、似然比、证据连乘：信念更新其实是一本流水账。
desc.en: The test says positive, yet your chance of actually having it is 9% — the test didn't lie; the base rate is thin. Priors, likelihood ratios and chained evidence: belief updating as a running ledger.
